name: OpenAgent
description: Self-hostable personal AI assistant shipped as one binary, combining LLM chat, your knowledge base and agent loops.
whatItDoes: Gives a user an assistant that answers from their own documents and can act autonomously, including computer-use, browser-use and coding tasks. Runs natively on Linux, macOS and Windows.
howItWorks: A Go backend with a web front end is served on port 14000. The installer downloads the latest release binary; Docker Compose and build-from-source paths are also documented.
